neighbours.label: a bare word-initial 'h'/'H' piece split off from the rest of a rare or unusual word (unh|indered, h|inders, H|artley)
fire: The new trade rules seriously hinder foreign investment in the region.
Children should be able to play unhindered by worries about money.
After the fire the volunteers hosed down the walls of the old barn.
The comet Hartley 2 was visited by a spacecraft in November 2010.
Bad weather hindered the rescue teams for most of the afternoon.
The village of Hethersett lies a few miles south of the city.
Engineers said the corrosion hampered progress on the bridge repairs.
The old manuscript was written in a hieratic script on papyrus.
quiet: The new trade rules seriously reduce foreign investment in the region.
Children should be able to play freely without worries about money.
After the fire the volunteers washed down the walls of the old barn.
The comet Tempel 1 was visited by a spacecraft in July 2005.
Bad weather slowed the rescue teams for most of the afternoon.
The village of Wymondham lies a few miles south of the city.
Engineers said the corrosion delayed progress on the bridge repairs.
The old manuscript was written in a cursive script on papyrus.

notes: both poles of this unit peak on bare ' h' pieces; the - pole examples lean to hinder/unhindered; tokenization of the fire words not checked
